result.reporting_boundary: TEP, PRONTO, and SKAB provide multi-sensor fault/anomaly labels and support M3/P1 NOZ and direction-transfer validation. Pump regression receives engineering activation only when held-out normal R2 and residual-normality gates pass; none is claimed as the original electrical-pump paper domain. Condenser equations are validated on book-parameter synthetic data only, while all real datasets are denied condenser activation because required variable identities and units are absent. SMD10TOWFGR is an event log, not a continuous multivariate process matrix.
